entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I'm a bit confused. I have this VeloBand Cadence Sensor, and it's just not working. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To get started, can I get your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable, order number VF789012. I just don't understand... the website said it was easy to set up.
Thank you, Sarah. I've pulled up your account. You received the VeloBand about 24 days ago. Can you tell me a little more about the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It feels like a fault. It's just not working right. It won't sync with my phone, and I think the pulse reader might be broken. I'm not very technical, I just wanted it to work. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Sarah. It sounds frustrating when a new device doesn't cooperate. Since you feel the item is defective, I can definitely look at our return options for you. One moment while I check the policy.
Oh, okay. I hope it's not too complicated. I just want this sorted out.
Alright, I've got it here. Let's see... my system shows that VeloFit items are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 24 days ago, you are well within that window.
Really? So I can just send it back? That would be such a relief.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're reporting the item as defective, I can process this as a return for a full refund for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. You just need to print it, put the VeloBand back in its box, and drop it off at the post office.
Wow, thank you so much, David! That's so much easier than I thought it would be. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. The email with the label is on its way. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
